title: pneumatopteris venulosa
intro: Pneumatopteris venulosa, commonly known as the tree fern, is a species of plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pneumatopteris venulosa include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
